descripcion_geo: Valley between Jerusalem and the Mount of Olives that descends towards the Dead Sea. Seasonal channel of the Kidrón torrent.
importancia_estrategica: Eastern border of Jerusalem; crossed by David in his flight and by Jesus on the way to Gethsemane.

historias.titulo: David crosses the Kidron in his flight
historias.descripcion: David crosses the Kidron torrent crying as he flees from Absalom, just as Jesus crossed the same valley before his arrest.

historias.titulo: Josiah burns the idols in the Kidron
historias.descripcion: The reformer king Josiah drags and burns all objects of pagan worship to the Kidron torrent.

historias.titulo: Jesus crosses the Kidron towards Gethsemane
historias.descripcion: After the Last Supper, Jesus crosses the Kidron stream with his disciples and enters the garden where he would be arrested.

personajes.descripcion: She crossed the Kidron in tears as she fled from her son; typological image of betrayal.
He used the Kidron as a place of religious purification, burning the idols.
He crossed the Kidron on the way to Gethsemane; The Fathers of the Church compare it with David.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Valley of passage and purification; Its crossing through David and Jesus makes it a symbol of the suffering of the righteous.

judaismo.descripcion: David crossed the Kidron crying; the prophets used the valley as a place of purification and judgment.
judaismo.significado_teologico: David crossed the Kidron crying; the prophets used the valley as a place of purification and judgment.

cristianismo.descripcion: Jesus crosses the Kidron before his passion, fulfilling the type of David in his suffering.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Jesus crosses the Kidron before his passion, fulfilling the type of David in his suffering.

historias.descripcion: After the Last Supper, Jesus and his disciples cross the Kidron to the garden of Gethsemane.
Judas knew the place because Jesus frequently met there with the disciples.
The crossing of the Kidron by Jesus recapitulates that of David: the innocent king crosses the valley towards his suffering.

personajes.descripcion: He crossed the Kidron on the night of his arrest.
He led the mob to the garden on the other side of the Kidron.
He crossed the Kidron with Jesus and later denied knowing him.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: The Kidron is the threshold between Jerusalem and Gethsemane; Their crossing marks the beginning of passion.

cristianismo.descripcion: The crossing of the Kidron by Jesus fulfills the Davidic type: the suffering king crosses the valley in his hour of betrayal.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The crossing of the Kidron by Jesus fulfills the Davidic type: the suffering king crosses the valley in his hour of betrayal.
